```{r}

library(readxl)

data_paper <- read_xlsx("data_paper.xlsx")
data_paper <- as.data.frame(data_paper)
data_paper

```




#Membuat Distribusi Jumlah Artikel berdasarkan Jurnal
```{r}


library(dplyr)

grup <- group_by(data_paper, `Nama Jurnal`, ISSN)

data_jurnal <- grup %>% summarise(
		freq = n()

)

data_jurnal <- as.data.frame(data_jurnal)

colnames(data_jurnal) = c("Journal", "ISSN", "Number of Articles in Our Database")

data_jurnal
```
























#Jumlah Keywords
```{r}

ambil_keyword <- data_paper[,"Keyword"]
ambil_keyword <- as.data.frame(ambil_keyword)

simpan_keyword <- vector(mode = "character")
  
  
for(i in 1 :  length(ambil_keyword[,1])  )
{
  
  X <- ambil_keyword[i,1]
  
  X <- tolower(X) #mengubah menjadi huruf kecil

      
      X <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(X), "  ;", fixed = TRUE))
      X <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(X), " ;", fixed = TRUE))
      X <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(X), ";  ", fixed = TRUE))
      X <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(X), "; ", fixed = TRUE))
      X <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(X), ";", fixed = TRUE))
      #X <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(X), ", ", fixed = TRUE))
      #  X <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(X), "  ,", fixed = TRUE))
           # X <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(X), " ,", fixed = TRUE))
           # X <- unlist(strsplit(as.character(X), ",", fixed = TRUE))
      
      simpan_keyword = c(simpan_keyword, X)
      
      
  
  
}



level_simpan_keyword <- as.factor(simpan_keyword)

level_simpan_keyword <- levels(level_simpan_keyword)

length(level_simpan_keyword)


level_simpan_keyword
```

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidytext)
library(widyr)


data_tes <- data_paper[c("No", "Judul Artikel")]

data_tes
```




```{r}

 nasa_title <- data_frame( id = data_tes$No, title = data_tes$`Judul Artikel`)

 nasa_title

```










```{r}

nasa_desc <- data_frame(id = data_paper$No, desc = data_paper$Keyword)
 
nasa_desc %>%
 select(desc) %>%
 sample_n(5)

```




```{r}
 library(tidyr)
 nasa_keyword <- data_frame(id = data_paper$No, keyword = data_paper$Keyword) %>% unnest(keyword)

 nasa_keyword

```






```{r}
 library(tidytext)
 nasa_keyword <- data_frame(id = data_paper$No, keyword = data_paper$Keyword) %>% unnest(keyword)

 nasa_keyword <-  nasa_keyword %>%  unnest_tokens(word, keyword) %>%  anti_join(stop_words)
 
 nasa_keyword


```



```{r}
 nasa_keyword %>%
 count(word, sort = TRUE)

```







```{r}
 library(tidytext)
 nasa_title <- data_frame( id = data_tes$No, title = data_tes$`Judul Artikel`)
 nasa_title <- nasa_title %>%  unnest_tokens(word, title) %>%  anti_join(stop_words)
 
 nasa_title


```







```{r}
 nasa_title %>%
 count(word, sort = TRUE)

```




```{r}
my_stopwords <- data_frame(word = c(as.character(1:2),
 "role", "students"))



 nasa_title <- data_frame( id = data_tes$No, title = data_tes$`Judul Artikel`)
 nasa_title <- nasa_title %>%  unnest_tokens(word, title) %>%  anti_join(stop_words)
 
 nasa_title %>%
 count(word, sort = TRUE)
 



```


```{r}

nasa_title <- nasa_title %>%
 anti_join(my_stopwords)


nasa_title


 nasa_title %>%
 count(word, sort = TRUE)
 
```



```{r}

 library(widyr)
 title_word_pairs <- nasa_title %>%
 pairwise_count(word, id, sort = TRUE, upper = FALSE)
 title_word_pairs

```





```{r}
library(ggplot2)
 library(igraph)
 library(ggraph)

 set.seed(1234)
 title_word_pairs %>%
  filter(n >= 7) %>%
  graph_from_data_frame() %>%
  ggraph(layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(aes(edge_alpha = n, edge_width = n), edge_colour = "cyan4") +
  geom_node_point(size = 5) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE,
                 point.padding = unit(0.2, "lines")) +
  theme_void()
 
 
```












```{r}

data_keyword <- data_paper[c("Keyword")]
data_keyword2 <- data_keyword

for(i in 1 : length(data_keyword[,1]))
{
  
  x <- data_keyword[i,1]
  
    simpan_keyword_hapus_spasi <- gsub(" ", "", x)
    simpan_keyword_hapus_spasi <- gsub("-", "", simpan_keyword_hapus_spasi)
    simpan_keyword_hapus_spasi <- gsub("'", "", simpan_keyword_hapus_spasi)
    
    data_keyword2[i,1] = simpan_keyword_hapus_spasi
    
    
  
  
}


data_keyword2
```





```{r}
 library(tidytext)
 nasa_keyword2 <- data_frame(id = c(1 :  length(data_keyword2[,1])  ), 
              keyword = data_keyword2$Keyword) %>% unnest(keyword)

 nasa_keyword2 <-  nasa_keyword2 %>%  unnest_tokens(word, keyword) %>%  anti_join(stop_words)
 
 nasa_keyword2


```





```{r}

 library(widyr)
 title_word_pairs <- nasa_keyword2 %>%
 pairwise_count(word, id, sort = TRUE, upper = FALSE)
 title_word_pairs

```





```{r}

  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE,
                 point.padding = unit(0.2, "lines")) +
```

```{r}


data_judol2 <- data_judol[c("Keyword")]

data_judol3 <- data_judol2

for(i in 1 : length(data_judol2[,1]))
{
  
  x <- data_judol2[i,1]
  
    simpan_keyword_hapus_spasi <- gsub(" ", "", x)
    simpan_keyword_hapus_spasi <- gsub("-", "", simpan_keyword_hapus_spasi)
    simpan_keyword_hapus_spasi <- gsub("'", "", simpan_keyword_hapus_spasi)
    
    data_judol3[i,1] = simpan_keyword_hapus_spasi
    
    
  
  
}


data_judol3
```




```{r}
 library(tidytext)
library(ggplot2)

library(dplyr)

nasa_judol
```


```{r}

  geom_node_point(size = 5) +

                 point.padding = unit(0.2, "lines")) +

```





